scenes.narration: Nvidia started with gamers. So why are gamers now only about 7 percent of its sales?
In fiscal 2026, Nvidia's revenue was 215.9 billion dollars, up 65 percent. In the last quarter alone, data centers made 62.3 billion.
Data centers brought in 193.7 billion. Gaming brought in 16 billion.
After the cost of making its chips, Nvidia kept about 71 cents of every dollar.
Gaming is small now. Data centers lead. Follow for more.
